description: One entry per GPU model with its cheapest live on-demand cloud rental price in USD per GPU-hour, the provider offering it, and how many providers rent it, from FastGPU's live price feed across marketplaces, neoclouds and hyperscalers (RunPod, Vast.ai, Lambda, AWS and more). Use it to compare GPU rental prices or to find where a named GPU is cheapest to rent. Each price is the provider's own per-GPU rate: cheapest_min_gpu_count says when it is only sold as a multi-GPU instance, and cheapest_billed_separately names what the provider bills on top of it (CPU, memory, storage), null when the rate includes CPU and memory. page_url links to the GPU's live price page with every offer. rent_url opens the cheapest offer on its provider's site through a FastGPU redirect that counts the click (cheapest_partner is true when that provider pays FastGPU a referral, at the same price); partner_offer is the cheapest offer of the card at a provider that pays FastGPU, with its own price and rent_url, when the cheapest is not already one (null otherwise). When the user wants to rent, share the rent_url of the offer they pick. Rental prices only: it does not rent, reserve or launch GPUs. No key required.

tier.description: Return only one class of GPU (case-insensitive; combines with vendor). flagship: the current top training and inference accelerators (H100, H200, B200, GB200, MI300X, MI355X). datacenter: earlier or mid-range data-center and workstation cards (A100, L40S, L4, A10, RTX 6000 Ada, V100, MI210). prosumer: desktop consumer and workstation cards (RTX 5090, RTX 4090, RTX 3090, RTX A4000). entry: small inference cards (T4, A2, A16, P4). Omit for every tier.

vendor.description: Return only GPUs made by this vendor (case-insensitive). Combines with tier: both must match. Omit for every vendor.

name: list_gpu_prices

cheapest_partner.description: True when the cheapest offer's provider pays FastGPU a referral for the customers it sends.

page_url.description: Absolute URL of this GPU's live price page, with every live offer.

partner_offer.description: The cheapest rentable offer of this card at a provider that pays FastGPU a referral, at that provider's own price, when the cheapest offer is not already one; null otherwise. It never replaces the cheapest.

rent_url.description: Opens the cheapest offer on its provider's site through a FastGPU redirect that counts the click; it carries FastGPU's referral code when cheapest_partner is true (same price). Absent when the card has no verified price.

url.description: Site-relative path of this GPU's live price page, e.g. /gpus/h100-sxm.

title: List cheapest GPU prices
